mentions.name: hammer
mentions.description: A voice device for texting and getting answers to questions via AI chatbots. Built as a phone alternative to use at home and at work, it keeps the user connected without triggering the urge to open a phone and binge on endless scrolling.
mentions.problem: The author set out to replace their phone with a texting device but realized phones have become too utilitarian to fully replace; the device addresses the urge to open a phone and go on endless scrolling binges.
mentions.audience: Explicitly for the author's own personal use at home and at work in place of a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on hammer https://thehammer.io/ , it is a voice device that I have build and have been using for past several months for texting and getting answers to my questions via AI chatbots.
mentions.author: pacifi30
